name: Patient
definition: An individual patient in the cohort. Each patient has one stable identifier and patient-level attributes such as sex, birth date, diagnosis date, first visit date, follow-up status and a patient-level diagnosis.

name: Patient Identifier
definition: The numeric identifier that links patient-level, diagnosis-record and laboratory-examination data. The same identifier domain is used by tab02.fld001, tab03.fld001 and tab01.fld001.
scope: Joining records across the three tables; linkage between tab01 and the other tables is incomplete (see constraint_tab01_patient_linkage).

name: Laboratory Examination
definition: A laboratory examination event for a patient on a given examination date, containing many concurrently measured laboratory values. Stored one row per patient per examination date.

name: Diagnosis Record
definition: A diagnosis event record that carries a diagnosis date, diagnosis label(s), symptoms and thrombosis-related status for a patient.
scope: tab01; each row is a diagnosis event.

name: Sex
definition: Patient sex recorded as 'M' (male) or 'F' (female); 13 patients have no recorded value.

name: Birthday
definition: Patient date of birth in ISO date form. A later date corresponds to a younger person; the maximum birthday identifies the youngest patient.

name: Age
definition: Patient age derived at year granularity as the current calendar year minus the birth year. It is an approximation because day-level elapsed time is not applied in the workload.
scope: Derived from birthday; used for age filters such as underage (<18) and older than 55.

name: Patient Diagnosis
definition: The patient-level diagnosis label stored on the patient record. Values are free-text, often multi-label and may include qualifiers such as 'susp'.

name: Diagnosis Record Label
definition: The diagnosis label attached to a diagnosis event record. It uses the same disease vocabulary as the patient-level diagnosis but differs in spelling variants and granularity.

name: Symptom
definition: Free-text description of observed symptoms or thrombotic manifestations recorded on a diagnosis event. Populated only when a thrombosis-related status code other than zero is present.

name: Thrombosis-Related Status
definition: Coded status recorded on a diagnosis event describing the presence and type of thrombosis-related complication: 0 = none, 1 = thrombotic event (for example AMI, brain infarction, DVT, thrombophlebitis, abortion), 2 = CNS lupus, 3 = thrombocytopenia.

name: Examination Date
definition: Date on which a laboratory examination was performed; ISO date text.
scope: tab03.fld019; together with the patient identifier it forms the laboratory record grain.

name: Diagnosis Date
definition: Patient-level date associated with the diagnosis on the patient record; ISO date text. Question wording such as 'came at the hospital in <year>' is mapped to this field in the workload, although its primary semantic role is the diagnosis date.

name: First Visit Date
definition: Patient's first visit date at the hospital; ISO date text and generally earlier than the diagnosis date. Question wording such as 'came to the hospital after <date>' is mapped to this field in the workload.

name: Diagnosis Record Date
definition: Date attached to a diagnosis event record; ISO date text. Question wording such as 'examined during <period>' can refer to this field when the diagnosis table is the source.

name: Laboratory Examination Count
definition: Number of laboratory examination records associated with a patient. Because tab03 is long-format, a patient with multiple visits has multiple records.
scope: Derived by counting laboratory records per patient.

name: Follow-Up Status
definition: Coded follow-up status on the patient record: '-' is treated in the workload as immediately followed at the outpatient clinic; '+' and '+(' are other follow-up states; some patients have no value.

name: Uric Acid
definition: Serum uric acid concentration recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit level recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Red Blood Cell Count
definition: Red blood cell count recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Lactate Dehydrogenase
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol concentration recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Prothrombin Time
definition: Prothrombin time (PT) recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Immunoglobulin A
definition: Immunoglobulin A (IgA) level recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody (aCL) measurement recorded in laboratory examinations.

name: Anti-Sm Antibody
definition: Anti-Sm antibody result recorded in laboratory examinations; stored as coded text values rather than numeric titres.

name: Percentage
definition: A part-to-whole proportion expressed as a percentage: part count divided by whole count, multiplied by 100.
scope: Derived metric used in cohort composition questions.

name: Sex Ratio
definition: Ratio of male patient count to female patient count (or another specified pair of subgroup counts).
scope: Derived metric used in cohort composition questions.

name: Decrease Rate
definition: Relative decrease between an earlier and a later measurement, computed as (earlier value minus later value) divided by the later value.
scope: Derived metric for month-over-month change in a laboratory value.

name: SLE Diagnosis
definition: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) appearing in a diagnosis label, including combination labels such as 'SLE, SJS' and qualifiers such as 'SLE susp'.
scope: Diagnosis labels in tab02.fld008 (and corresponding values in tab01.fld008).

name: RA Diagnosis
definition: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) appearing as a diagnosis label component, including variants such as 'RA susp', 'RA (seronegative)' and combination labels. MRA and Raynaud are different entities.
scope: Diagnosis labels in tab02.fld008 (and corresponding values in tab01.fld008).

name: APS Diagnosis
definition: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) appearing in a diagnosis label, including combination labels such as 'APS, RA susp' and 'SLE, APS'.
